THE ECHO BELOW · SCENE
Area 3 · Old entrance and ceiling stirges
Change prepared scene
Say aloud

Carved miners still work along the walls above a floor strewn with ancient bones. Empty brass lamps hang in the stone. Beyond them, the high ceiling disappears into shadow.

The abandoned lamps offer no light of their own. Your illumination catches the miners' carved tools and the pale bones at different heights, leaving the upper space harder to judge. You can inspect the floor, examine the figures on the walls, or direct your attention toward the ceiling.

Ask the players

Are you studying the carvings, searching the bodies, watching the ceiling, or passing through?
